description: A reviewer's final answer (PRD 23.3-23.5). scripts/ralph/review.sh adds task, reviewer, inputs, timestamps, finding ids and empty resolutions around it.

verdict.description: PASS only if every acceptance criterion passed on evidence and no finding is blocker or high.

checks.description: One entry per acceptance criterion and per check command.

command.description: Command run, or null if judged by reading.

evidence.description: Output excerpt or file:line. For NOT_RUN, the concrete reason.

severity.description: blocker: a criterion fails or a scientific or safety rule is broken. high: likely defect, or a required behaviour is untested. medium: fix before merge. low: optional.
